en.title: When to use the passive
en.summary: Use the passive when the doer is unknown, unimportant or obvious.

paragraphs: The passive is not just another way of saying the same thing. A speaker chooses it because of what the sentence is about. Choosing the right voice makes a text clearer and more natural.

items: Doer unimportant: **The bridge was built in 1890.**
Doer obvious: **The thief was arrested.** (by the police)

blocks.html:
ReasonExample
the doer is unknownThe window was broken during the night.
the doer is not importantEnglish is spoken in many countries.
the doer is obviousThe prisoners were released.
we want the focus on the resultThe museum was opened by the Queen.
formal or scientific styleThe samples were heated to 100 degrees.
to avoid blamingMistakes were made.

paragraphs: English likes to begin a sentence with known information and end it with new information. If the object is what you have been talking about, the passive lets you start with it: We visited the cathedral. It was built in the twelfth century by monks.
Use the active when the doer is important and the sentence is direct and personal. Too many passives make writing heavy and impersonal.

blocks.html:
HeavyClearer
The decision was made by the committee that the fees should be raised.The committee decided to raise the fees.
It is believed by many people that...Many people believe that...

items: Do not use the passive with intransitive verbs: **The meeting was taken place** is wrong. Say **took place**.
Avoid long chains of passives. One passive per sentence is usually enough.
Do not drop the agent when it is the key information: **Hamlet was written by Shakespeare**, not just Hamlet was written.

ro.title: Când folosim pasivul
ro.summary: Folosim diateza pasivă când acțiunea este importantă, iar autorul acțiunii este necunoscut, evident sau neimportant.

paragraphs: Diateza pasivă arată că subiectul suferă acțiunea. O folosim când nu știm cine face acțiunea. De asemenea, o folosim când autorul acțiunii este evident sau neimportant. În vorbirea de zi cu zi, preferăm adesea diateza activă.

Formăm pasivul cu verbul „a fi” și participiul verbului de bază. Participiul se acordă în gen și număr cu subiectul. Putem adăuga autorul acțiunii cu prepoziția „de” sau „de către”. Dacă autorul este cel mai important, alegem diateza activă.

blocks.html:
SituațieExempluExplicație
Autor necunoscutBicicleta a fost furată.Nu știm cine a luat bicicleta.
Autor evidentPacientul a fost operat.Medicul a făcut operația, este de la sine înțeles.
Autor neimportantMuzeul a fost deschis recent.Evenimentul contează, nu persoana care l-a deschis.
Accent pe rezultatTema a fost terminată.Rezultatul final este mai important decât persoana care a lucrat.
